core.claims: every change to the base is on the ledger, the chain replays from genesis, the rhythm pass is done and every bar has been heard against the page

marks.claims: the MARKS layer was read bar by bar against the source and corrected by hand — it is NOT reconciled across readers

route.claims: the piece has no repeats or jumps, or they were checked by hand

engraving.claims: the file does not contradict itself: no half ties, no beam broken inside its group, no unpaired slur or hairpin or pedal — NOT that the engraving matches the page
